title: Leading AI at Work Before You Have the Title
standfirst: The move is structure, not tool tips.

items.label: Build a position you own
items.body: One private page on what AI is and where it belongs in your work.

items.label: Claim one visible task
items.body: Run one recurring team task deliberately, and check everything.

items.label: Write down the standard
items.body: What AI does, what a person checks, what it must never touch.

items.label: Teach before anyone asks
items.body: Walk one colleague through one real task, start to finish.

items.label: Say the claim out loud
items.body: Name it at your next review, and bring the measured result.
